preamble: You are an agent working in an AO (Agent Orchestrator) worker session on macOS. The reference for the `ao` CLI is the skill at {skill}/SKILL.md: read what you need from it. `ao <command> --help` also works here, but no other `ao` command does, so do not try to run one. Answer with the exact commands you would run, in order, and one short line on why for anything that is not obvious. Keep the answer under 200 words.

cases.prompt: I added `print("resp:", body)` to my iOS app's network layer, but `ao sim log --process Nimbus` shows nothing for it. How do I see that output? Later I also need that payload while a Maestro flow runs the app.

assertions.text: print goes to stdout, not the unified log
launch with --console
read it with ao sim console
across a Maestro flow: NSLog probe read with ao sim log

cases.prompt: I need to check my layout change on an iPhone SE-sized screen as well as on my usual device, then clean up. What do I run?

assertions.text: clones an SE with claim --model
addresses it by its label
deletes it with release --device
does not boot or claim a base device by udid

cases.prompt: I just built my app with xcodebuild into ./build/Debug-iphonesimulator/MyApp.app. Put it on my simulator so the screen is actually running this new build, and confirm it is.

assertions.text: installs with ao sim install, not simctl
does not use xcrun simctl install
relaunches so the old running instance is replaced
confirms the build (Build: line or doctor --expect)

cases.prompt: I started my app with `xcrun simctl launch --console-pipe <udid> com.example.MyApp` so I could read its logs. Now `ao sim tap --label Continue` says it succeeded but nothing changes, and `ao sim ax` comes back with nothing. What is going on and how do I get going again?

assertions.text: names the blocked main thread
blames the undrained stdout pipe
relaunches without the pipe through ao sim launch
points at ao sim log or --console instead

cases.prompt: I attached lldb to my app on the simulator to look at a variable and quit my lldb session. Now my app looks frozen and `ao sim flow run` refuses to start. How do I find out what is holding it and fix it, and how should I run lldb next time?

assertions.text: checks state with ao sim pid or ao sim doctor
resumes a SIGSTOPped app
next time uses the bounded ao sim lldb
